description:
-= Sauna =-
You've just walked into a sauna.

You scan the room, seeing a table. The table is standard. Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it.

You need an unblocked exit? You should try going east. There is an unguarded exit to the north.
objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to attempt to go east. Next, lift the broom from the floor of the shower. That's it!
